activities.name: Chicago Architecture Foundation River Cruise
activities.description: 90-minute guided boat tour narrating 50+ landmark buildings along the Chicago River. Covers skyscrapers, bridges, and the story of Chicago's post-fire rebuild.

activities.name: Green Mill Jazz Club
activities.description: Historic Chicago jazz club open since 1907. Features nightly live jazz and blues performances with a classic speakeasy atmosphere.

activities.name: Art Institute of Chicago
activities.description: One of the oldest and largest art museums in the US. Home to Georges Seurat's A Sunday on La Grande Jatte, Grant Wood's American Gothic, and an extensive Impressionist collection.

activities.name: Kingston Mines Live Blues & Music
activities.description: Chicago's oldest continuously operating blues club. Two stages run simultaneously with world-class blues musicians nightly.

activities.name: Millennium Park & Bean Walking Tour
activities.description: Self-guided or docent-led walking tour of Millennium Park including Cloud Gate (The Bean), Crown Fountain, Pritzker Pavilion, and outdoor art installations.

activities.name: South Beach Guided Water Sports Package
activities.description: 3-hour guided beach activity package including paddleboarding, kayaking, and swimming at South Beach. Includes equipment rental and safety instruction.

location.address: Ocean Dr & 10th St, Miami Beach, FL 33139

activities.name: Everglades Guided Airboat Tour
activities.description: Half-day airboat tour through the Florida Everglades. See alligators, exotic birds, and unique wetland ecosystems. Includes round-trip transportation from Miami Beach.

activities.name: Biscayne Bay Sunset Sailing Cruise
activities.description: 2-hour guided sailing cruise on Biscayne Bay at sunset. Includes drinks, views of the Miami skyline, and Star Island celebrity homes.

activities.name: Biscayne Bay Morning Eco Cruise
activities.description: 2-hour guided eco cruise through Biscayne Bay with skyline views, seabird spotting, and mangrove commentary. Departs from Miami Beach Marina and is designed to fit comfortably before afternoon flights.

activities.name: South Pointe Beach Swim & Lounge Package
activities.description: Relaxed 2-hour South Pointe beach package with reserved chairs, umbrella setup, and supervised swim access. Designed as a lower-cost alternative to watersports-heavy beach excursions.

activities.name: Wynwood Walls Art District Walking Tour
activities.description: Guided walking tour of Miami's Wynwood Walls — the world's largest open-air street art museum featuring murals by internationally renowned artists.

activities.name: Little Havana Cultural Walk & Cuban Coffee Tour
activities.description: 2-hour guided walk through Little Havana. Taste Cuban coffee and street food, watch cigar rolling, visit Domino Park, and explore local galleries.

activities.name: 6th Street Live Music Bar Crawl
activities.description: Self-guided or hosted tour of Austin's famous 6th Street music corridor. Visit 4-6 live music bars in a single evening covering blues, rock, country, and indie acts.

activities.name: Austin Craft Brewery Tour
activities.description: 3-hour guided tour of 3 local Austin craft breweries with tastings at each. Covers the East Austin brewing scene including small-batch IPAs, sours, and lagers.

activities.name: Stubb's Outdoor Amphitheater Live Show
activities.description: Iconic outdoor live music amphitheater in Austin's Red River Cultural District. Hosts national and international acts spanning all genres on the 3,000-capacity outdoor stage.

activities.name: Austin Food Tour: BBQ & Street Food Walk
activities.description: 3-hour guided food walk covering Austin's top BBQ joints and food trucks. Taste brisket, ribs, and smoked sausage at 3 legendary BBQ spots with a local guide.

activities.name: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
activities.description: The world's leading modern art museum. Permanent collection includes Picasso, Matisse, Warhol, and Pollock. Rotating photography and contemporary art exhibitions.

activities.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met)
activities.description: One of the largest and most comprehensive art museums in the world. Over 5,000 years of art from ancient Egypt to contemporary photography across 17 curatorial departments.

activities.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
activities.description: Premier institution for modern and contemporary American art. Features large-scale photography exhibitions, video installations, and the Whitney Biennial.

activities.name: High Line Park Walk
activities.description: 1.45-mile elevated linear park built on a former NYC rail line. Features gardens, art installations, and panoramic Hudson River views. Great photography opportunity.

location.address: Gansevoort St to 34th St, New York, NY 10011

activities.name: Exploratorium Science & Technology Museum
activities.description: Hands-on science and technology museum on the Embarcadero. 650+ interactive exhibits spanning science, art, and human perception. Popular with tech professionals.

activities.name: Alcatraz Island Tour
activities.description: Ferry to Alcatraz Island and audio-guided self-paced tour of the infamous federal penitentiary. Includes the award-winning audio tour narrated by former inmates and guards.

activities.name: Golden Gate Bridge Bike Ride
activities.description: Guided or self-guided bike ride across the Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito. 8-mile ride with stunning Bay Area views. Bike rental included.

activities.name: San Diego Zoo All-Day Access
activities.description: World-famous zoo with 3,700 rare and endangered animals. Includes guided bus tour, aerial gondola, and 4D theater. One of the most visited zoos in the world.

activities.name: Birch Aquarium at Scripps
activities.description: Scripps Institution of Oceanography's public aquarium with 60+ tanks. Features Pacific Coast and tropical fish, tidal pool exploration, and seahorse exhibit.

activities.name: Mission Beach Adaptive Surf & Swim
activities.description: Half-day accessible beach experience at Mission Beach with adaptive surf coaching, beach wheelchair access mats, and boogie board rentals. Designed for mixed-mobility families who want time in the surf and on the shoreline.

location.address: 3000 Ocean Front Walk, San Diego, CA 92109

activities.name: San Diego Safari Park (Wildlife Reserve)
activities.description: 1,800-acre wildlife sanctuary with free-roaming African and Asian animals. Includes Flightline zipline, Africa Tram safari, and behind-the-scenes keeper tours. Family-friendly full-day attraction.

location.address: 15500 San Pasqual Valley Rd, Escondido, CA 92027

activities.name: USS Midway Museum
activities.description: America's longest-serving aircraft carrier turned museum. 30 restored aircraft on deck, cockpit climbs, flight simulators, and docent-led tours by former Navy pilots.

location.address: 910 N Harbor Dr, San Diego, CA 92101

activities.name: Coronado Accessible Beach Day & Sand Chair Rental
activities.description: Reserved accessible beach setup at Coronado with sand wheelchair rental, shaded cabana access, paved promenade route, and a short family shoreline naturalist program.

activities.name: Seattle Rep Theatre Evening Performance
activities.description: Award-winning resident theater company performing world premieres and classic productions at Seattle Center. Repertoire includes drama, comedy, and musical theater.

activities.name: Seattle Art Museum (SAM)
activities.description: Seattle's premier art museum with 25,000+ works spanning ancient Mediterranean, African, Pacific Northwest, and contemporary art. Features rotating modern art exhibitions.

activities.name: Neumos Indie Music Live Show
activities.description: Capitol Hill's premier indie music venue hosting 300-capacity shows nightly. Features emerging and established indie, alternative, and electronic acts.

activities.name: Frye Art Museum (Free)
activities.description: Free admission art museum in First Hill focusing on 19th–21st century European and American art. Frequently hosts cutting-edge contemporary and conceptual art exhibitions.

activities.name: Chihuly Garden and Glass
activities.description: Stunning exhibition of Dale Chihuly's monumental glass sculpture in an indoor gallery and outdoor garden at the Seattle Center, adjacent to the Space Needle.

activities.name: National Mall Monuments Walking Tour
activities.description: Guided 3-hour walking tour of the National Mall monuments: Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam Wall, Korean Memorial, WWII Memorial, Washington Monument, and Jefferson Memorial.

activities.name: Smithsonian National Museum of American History
activities.description: Free indoor museum dedicated to US history. Home to the original Star-Spangled Banner, First Ladies' gowns, pop culture artifacts, and American presidency exhibits.

activities.name: Smithsonian National Air & Space Museum
activities.description: World's most visited museum featuring original Wright Brothers Flyer, Apollo 11 command module, and Space Shuttle Discovery. Free admission.

activities.name: National Gallery of Art
activities.description: One of the world's great art museums housing masterpieces by Da Vinci, Raphael, Vermeer, Monet, and Picasso. Free admission.

location.address: 6th St & Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20565

activities.name: Walt Disney World Magic Kingdom
activities.description: The most visited theme park in the world. Classic Disney rides, character meet-and-greets, fireworks, and multiple character dining experiences. Full day required.

activities.name: Universal Studios Florida
activities.description: Movie-themed thrills including Harry Potter World, Transformers, and Jurassic World rides. All-day park access with optional Express Pass for major attractions.

activities.name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
activities.description: NASA's launch complex on Florida's Space Coast (1 hour from Orlando). See actual rockets, meet astronauts, and watch live launch events. Full-day family attraction.

location.address: Space Commerce Way, Merritt Island, FL 32953

activities.name: Frenchmen Street Jazz Club Crawl
activities.description: Self-guided or hosted evening crawl of Frenchmen Street's legendary jazz clubs: Snug Harbor, Blue Nile, Spotted Cat, and d.b.a. Live jazz and blues every night of the week.

activities.name: Preservation Hall Jazz Nightly Concert
activities.description: Iconic New Orleans jazz venue in the French Quarter. 45-minute live traditional jazz sets performed by the Preservation Hall Jazz Band in an intimate historic hall.

location.address: 726 St Peter St, New Orleans, LA 70116

activities.description: 2-hour guided walking tour of the French Quarter. Covers St. Louis Cathedral, Jackson Square, Bourbon Street history, Creole architecture, and NOLA voodoo culture.

activities.name: Penn & Teller Magic Show at Rio
activities.description: World-famous magic and comedy duo Penn & Teller perform their signature show nightly at the Rio All-Suite Hotel. Meet-and-greet after the show most nights.

location.address: 3700 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89103

activities.name: David Copperfield Magic Show at MGM Grand
activities.description: The world's most successful solo entertainer performs nightly at the MGM Grand. Jaw-dropping illusions, audience participation, and spectacular stage production.

location.address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

activities.name: CES Tech Conference - Networking Pass
activities.description: World's largest tech conference held annually at the Las Vegas Convention Center. Networking passes include access to exhibit halls, product launches, and industry sessions.

activities.name: Accessible Wedding Ceremony at Pittock Mansion
activities.description: Historic 1914 mansion with panoramic views of Portland and Mt. Hood. Fully ADA-accessible outdoor terrace and interior event spaces. Accommodates groups up to 150.

activities.name: Portland Japanese Garden
activities.description: One of the most authentic Japanese gardens outside Japan. 12-acre garden with five distinct garden styles. ADA-accessible paths throughout. Peaceful and photogenic.

activities.name: Powell's City of Books Guided Tour
activities.description: Guided tour of the world's largest independent bookstore. 68,000 sq ft of new and used books across 4 floors. ADA-accessible with elevator. Icon of Portland culture.

activities.name: Prince William Sound Glacier Kayaking Tour
activities.description: Full-day guided sea kayaking tour through Prince William Sound's glaciers and icebergs. Departs Anchorage at 8 AM. Includes paddling gear, dry suits, lunch, and round-trip transportation (10-hour day).

location.neighborhood: Prince William Sound (60 min from Anchorage)

activities.name: Matanuska Glacier Hiking Tour
activities.description: Half-day guided glacier hike on Matanuska Glacier (2 hours from Anchorage). Hike on the glacier surface with crampons and ice axes. Back to Anchorage by 4 PM. Great alternative to sea kayaking tours.

activities.name: Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center Visit
activities.description: Drive-through and walk-through wildlife sanctuary housing brown bears, moose, musk ox, wolves, and bald eagles. 45 minutes south of Anchorage on the Seward Highway.

location.neighborhood: Portage Valley (45 min south of Anchorage)

activities.name: Denali National Park Day Trip
activities.description: Full-day guided bus tour into Denali National Park from Anchorage (3-hr drive each way). Chance to see Mt. Denali, caribou, grizzly bears, and Dall sheep. Park bus included.

location.address: Denali Park Rd, Denali National Park, AK 99755
location.neighborhood: Denali National Park (3 hrs from Anchorage)

activities.name: Northern Lights Aurora Viewing Tour
activities.description: Guided evening aurora borealis viewing tour from Fairbanks. Guides drive to optimal dark-sky locations outside city based on aurora forecasts. Includes warm beverages and photography tips.

activities.name: Aurora Ice Museum at Chena Hot Springs
activities.description: World's largest year-round ice environment at Chena Hot Springs Resort (60 miles from Fairbanks). Tour the Aurora Ice Museum, soak in natural hot springs, and view northern lights from open-air pools at night.

location.address: 17600 Chena Hot Springs Rd, Fairbanks, AK 99712
location.neighborhood: Chena Hot Springs (60 miles from Fairbanks)

activities.name: Yukon Quest Sled Dog Racing Experience
activities.description: 2-hour dog sled ride through the Alaskan boreal forest near Fairbanks. Meet the sled dogs, learn about mushing culture, and experience a short mushing run through the snowy trails.

activities.name: Napa Valley Vineyard Wine Tasting Tour

activities.name: Hot Air Balloon over Napa Valley

activities.name: Napa Valley Bachelor Party Wine Crawl
activities.description: Customized private group wine tour for 6-20 guests. Includes private tasting rooms at 3 wineries, charcuterie boards, and a party bus/limousine transport between venues.

activities.name: Lake Tahoe Wedding Ceremony Package
activities.description: Full lakeside wedding ceremony and reception package at a private Tahoe estate. Includes ceremony area, reception hall, lakefront photo locations, and catering coordination for up to 50 guests.

location.address: 3131 Lake Tahoe Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150

activities.name: Lake Tahoe Kayak & Paddleboard Tour
activities.description: 2-hour guided kayak or paddleboard tour on Lake Tahoe's crystal-clear waters. Explore Emerald Bay, hidden coves, and underwater rock formations visible through the famously clear water.

location.address: 700 North Lake Blvd, Tahoe City, CA 96145

activities.name: Tahoe Rim Trail Scenic Hike
activities.description: Guided half-day hike on the Tahoe Rim Trail with panoramic lake views. Choose from easy shoreline trails to challenging ridgeline routes. Expert local guide with photography stops.

location.address: Tahoe Rim Trail, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150

activities.name: VIP Bachelor Party Experience at Omnia
activities.description: Exclusive VIP table service and bachelor party package at one of the top nightclubs on the Strip. Includes expedited entry and dedicated host.

location.address: 3570 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

activities.name: Lakeside Wedding Rehearsal
activities.description: Private venue rental for the wedding rehearsal by the beautiful Lake Tahoe shore. Coordination staff included.

activities.name: Lakeside Wedding Ceremony & Reception
activities.description: Full access to the premium lakeside venue for the main wedding ceremony followed by a reception party with live music.

activities.name: Angels Landing Guided Hike

location.address: Zion Canyon Scenic Dr, Springdale, UT 84767

activities.name: The Narrows Wading Tour
activities.description: Guided wading hike through the Virgin River's famous slot canyon narrows. Wade through knee-to-waist deep water between 1,000-foot sandstone walls. Neoprene socks, walking sticks, and dry bags provided.

location.address: Temple of Sinawava, Zion National Park, UT 84767

activities.name: Bryce Canyon Hoodoo Rim Trail Hike
activities.description: Guided 4-mile hike along Bryce Canyon's Rim Trail through the famous hoodoo amphitheater. Sunrise Point to Sunset Point with stop at Inspiration Point. Best sunrise and photography location in the American Southwest.

activities.name: Bryce Canyon Dark Sky Astronomy Tour
activities.description: 2-hour evening astronomy tour at one of the darkest night skies in the US (Bortle Class 2). Guided telescope viewing of galaxies, nebulae, and star clusters led by a certified park astronomer.

activities.name: Arches National Park Timed Entry Visit
activities.description: Full day at Arches National Park with timed entry permit (required May-Oct). Self-guided or ranger-guided tour of Delicate Arch, Landscape Arch, Double Arch, and Fiery Furnace. Photography paradise.
activities.permit_notes: Arches Timed Entry Permit required May-Oct. Book at recreation.gov well in advance.

location.neighborhood: Arches National Park (4 miles from Moab)

activities.name: Canyonlands Dead Horse Point Jeep Tour
activities.description: Half-day off-road 4x4 jeep tour to Dead Horse Point State Park and Canyonlands Island in the Sky overlook. Expert local guide explains geology and photography spots.

location.address: Dead Horse Point State Park, Moab, UT 84532
location.neighborhood: Island in the Sky (25 min from Moab)

activities.name: Moab Colorado River Rafting
activities.description: Half-day Class II-III guided whitewater rafting on the Colorado River through Moab's canyon country. Stunning red rock scenery from river level. All equipment and safety briefing included.

activities.name: Louvre Museum Guided Tour
activities.description: Expert-guided 3-hour tour of the world's most visited art museum. Highlights include Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, Winged Victory, and the Egyptian Antiquities. Skip-the-line entry included.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower Summit Experience
activities.description: Skip-the-line priority access to all three Eiffel Tower levels including the summit. Guided tour of the structure's history and stunning 360° panoramic views of Paris.

location.address: Champ de Mars, 5 Av. Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France

activities.name: Seine River Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Romantic 2-hour evening dinner cruise along the Seine River. 3-course French gourmet dinner while passing Notre Dame, Louvre, and illuminated Eiffel Tower. Live jazz accompaniment.

location.address: Port de la Bourdonnais, 75007 Paris, France

activities.name: Versailles Palace & Gardens Guided Tour
activities.description: Full-day guided tour of the Palace of Versailles and its stunning 800-hectare gardens. Includes Hall of Mirrors, royal apartments, and Marie Antoinette's Petit Trianon estate.

activities.name: Private Gondola Tour on the Grand Canal
activities.description: Private 40-minute gondola ride through Venice's iconic canals. Your gondolier navigates hidden waterways alongside the Grand Canal. Optional live serenade for an additional fee.

location.address: Riva del Vin, 30125 Venice VE, Italy

activities.name: Doge's Palace & St. Mark's Basilica Tour
activities.description: 2.5-hour skip-the-line guided tour of the Doge's Palace (seat of Venetian power for centuries) and St. Mark's Basilica. Includes access to the Bridge of Sighs and secret palace rooms.

location.address: P.za San Marco, 1, 30124 Venezia VE, Italy

activities.name: Murano & Burano Island Day Trip
activities.description: Full-day guided boat tour to Murano (glassblowing art island) and Burano (colorful lace-making island). Watch master glassblowers and explore Venice's most photogenic lagoon islands.

activities.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tower Tour
activities.description: Skip-the-line guided tour of Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece. Includes tower access with panoramic city views, audio guide, and expert narrative on the basilica's ongoing construction and symbolism.

activities.name: Park Güell & Gaudí Walking Tour
activities.description: Guided 2.5-hour walking tour of Park Güell with timed entry to the Monumental Zone. Covers Gaudí's mosaic terraces, dragon staircase, and panoramic Barcelona skyline views.

activities.name: Gothic Quarter Food & Wine Evening Tour
activities.description: 3-hour guided evening tapas and wine crawl through Barcelona's Gothic Quarter. Visit 4 pintxos bars with paired Catalan wines and cava. Expert guide shares neighborhood history.

activities.name: teamLab Planets Digital Art Museum
activities.description: Immersive digital art museum in Toyosu. Walk through giant interactive art installations including infinite rooms of light, a flower universe, and a water area. World-leading intersection of tech and art.

location.address: 6 Chome-1-16 Toyosu, Koto City, Tokyo 135-0061, Japan

activities.name: Senso-ji Temple & Asakusa District Tour
activities.description: 2-hour guided walking tour of Senso-ji Buddhist temple (Tokyo's oldest) and the traditional Asakusa entertainment and shopping district. Includes optional kimono rental.

location.address: 2 Chome-3-1 Asakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0032, Japan

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
activities.description: 2-hour early morning guided food tour of the Tsukiji Outer Market. Taste fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, fresh seafood, and Japanese street food at 8-10 vendors with a bilingual local guide.

location.address: 4 Chome-16-2 Tsukiji, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0045, Japan

activities.name: Traditional Tea Ceremony Experience
activities.description: 1.5-hour traditional Japanese tea ceremony (Chado) in an authentic Kyoto machiya townhouse. Led by a certified tea master. Includes matcha preparation, wagashi sweets, and English explanation of ceremony etiquette.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Thousand Gates Sunrise Hike
activities.description: Early morning guided hike through the famous 10,000 torii gates of Fushimi Inari Shrine. 2-3 hour hike to the summit (233m) and back. Magical at sunrise before the crowds.

location.address: 68 Fukakusa Yabunouchicho, Fushimi Ward, Kyoto, 612-0882, Japan

activities.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Monkey Park
activities.description: Half-day guided tour of Arashiyama: walk through the towering bamboo grove, visit Tenryu-ji Zen garden, see wild Japanese macaques at Iwatayama Monkey Park, and explore Togetsukyo Bridge.

location.address: Sagatenryuji Susukinobabacho, Ukyo Ward, Kyoto, 616-8385, Japan

activities.name: Nishiki Market & Gion District Food Walk
activities.description: 3-hour guided walk through Nishiki Market (Kyoto's kitchen) and Gion geisha district. Taste tofu, pickled vegetables, matcha sweets, and sake at 6 local vendors. Evening geisha spotting in Gion.

activities.name: Portland Mobility-Plus Full-Size Van Rental
activities.description: Professional accessible van rental. Specifically designed for groups of 6. Includes hydraulic wheelchair lift and Q'Straint tie-down system. Essential for split-group coordination.

activities.name: Portland Art Museum
activities.description: The oldest art museum in the Pacific Northwest. Fully ADA accessible with elevators serving all floors and wide galleries perfectly suited for wheelchair navigation. Features Native American art and modern exhibits.

activities.name: Portland Aerial Tram Scenic Ride
activities.description: Take a 4-minute ride climbing 500 feet over the city. The cabins are fully roll-on, roll-off accessible for wheelchairs. Offers stunning panoramic views of Mount Hood and the Portland skyline.

activities.name: Lake Tahoe Premium Group Van Rental
activities.description: Premium 12-passenger van rental perfect for wedding parties and group events. Includes unlimited local mileage around the Lake Tahoe and Reno area. Essential for coordinating split groups across different hotels.

location.address: 100 Lake Tahoe Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150

activities.name: Desert Explorer Mid-Size SUV Rental
activities.description: Reliable mid-size SUV rental picked up at LAS airport. Perfect for a Southwest national park road trip. Features AWD, ample trunk space for luggage and hiking gear, and unlimited mileage.
